en.headline: Northern Metropolis Development Ordinance gazetted after LegCo passage
en.dek: The ordinance, passed on 12 November, provides a legal basis for faster planning, land and building measures, with subsidiary legislation targeted for early 2027.
body: The Northern Metropolis Development Ordinance was gazetted on Friday, after the Legislative Council passed it at third reading on 12 November.

The ordinance provides the legal basis for facilitation measures covering town planning, land compensation, building works approvals, noise control and cross-boundary flows, aimed at speeding up development in the area.

The Development Bureau and relevant bureaux are preparing the first batch of subsidiary legislation, with a view to tabling them for the Legislative Council in January and bringing them into effect in the first quarter of 2027.

Authorities said the Northern Metropolis will serve as a platform for university towns, innovation and technology, industry and liveable communities, supporting Hong Kong’s integration into the Greater Bay Area.

zh.headline: 《北部都會區發展條例》刊憲 為北都發展提供法律基礎
zh.dek: 條例經立法會11月12日三讀通過後今日刊憲，首批附屬法例計劃明年一月提交、首季生效。
body: 《北部都會區發展條例》周五刊憲。條例已於11月12日在立法會三讀通過。
條例為城市規劃、收地補償、建築工程審批、噪音管制及便利跨境流動等措施提供法律基礎，旨在加快北部都會區的發展建設。
發展局及相關政策局正敲定首批附屬法例，計劃明年一月提交立法會審議，目標於2027年第一季生效。
當局表示，北部都會區將以大學城、創科、產業及宜居宜業宜遊為發展布局，是香港深度參與大灣區建設的主平台。
